meta.name: refactor
meta.description: Intelligent refactor command. Triggers: refactor, refactoring, cleanup, restructure, extract, simplify, modernize.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 重构代码结构，消除坏味道，提升可维护性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果代码变得难以维护，需要系统性地改善结构
copy.tagline_en: Restructure code, eliminate bad smells, and improve maintainability
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your codebase has become hard to maintain and needs systematic structural improvement

howto.what: 当你要重构代码时，Claude会先明确你的意图，再分析代码库、构建依赖图、评估测试覆盖，最后逐步执行重构并在每一步自动验证。
howto.when: 当你使用 /refactor 命令或提到 refactor、cleanup、restructure 等触发词时接管。

say.text: 把 src/auth/handler.ts 中的验证逻辑提取到单独模块。
重构整个项目的 API 调用部分，使用新的错误处理模式。
say.note: 会先评估范围并生成计划。

say.text: 将 UserService 类改名为 MemberService。
say.note: 使用 LSP 重命名并更新所有引用。

howto.what_en: When you ask to refactor code, Claude will first understand your intent, then analyze the codebase, build a dependency map, assess test coverage, generate a detailed plan, and execute refactoring step by step with automatic verification after each step.
howto.when_en: The skill activates when you use the /refactor command or mention keywords such as refactor, cleanup, restructure, extract, simplify, modernize.

say_en.text: Extract the validation logic from src/auth/handler.ts into a separate module.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze and perform the extraction.

say_en.text: Refactor all API call parts in the project to use the new error handling pattern.
say_en.note: It will assess scope and generate a plan first.

say_en.text: Rename the UserService class to MemberService.
say_en.note: Uses LSP rename and updates all references.
